title: Unify pilot and blunder annotator game data into a shared snapshot format
description:
The pilot and blunder annotator see significantly different representations of the same game state:

- Pilot assembles state live from MCP tool calls (get_game_state, get_action_choices, get_oracle_text)
- Blunder annotator reconstructs state post-hoc from exported .json.gz snapshots (captured by spectator client)
- Different data sources: pilot uses XMage CardRepository for oracle text, annotator uses Scryfall API
- Different detail levels: pilot gets mana pool, untapped lands, land_drops_used, playable flags; annotator doesn't
- Different structure: pilot gets structured JSON per tool call; annotator gets a compact text summary

Long-term, build a canonical "decision snapshot" format that both consumers read. This may require sacrificing the constraint that all dynamic data visible to the pilot comes directly from MCP tool calls. For example, the bridge could emit structured snapshots at decision time that get both served to the pilot and persisted for the annotator.

Benefits:
- Blunder annotator judges decisions based on exactly what the pilot saw (fair evaluation)
- Single place to add new game state fields (no dual maintenance)
- Golden prompt tests validate the shared format
- Easier to add new analysis tools that consume the same data
